text:
alex-recruiter: Quick heads-up 10% verbal accept from Kai Patel (senior infra). We need a comp-band exception and a sign-on payment split for cross-border relocation tax reasons. Proposed comp: total cash $285k (base 170k / target 55k / sign-on 60k). Request: elevate to band E5 and sign-on paid 50% at start / 50% at 6mo. Start date requested 2026-05-20 but flexible +/- 2 weeks.

nina-peopleops: Please upload the offer packet + relocation tax memo and confirm manager sign-off. Also include whether sign-on will be grossed-up or not.

kai-hm: Confirm manager sign-off (Kai HM). This is a time-sensitive hire; candidate has two offers. Manager prefers earlier start if paperwork allows.

alex-recruiter: Uploaded: `gdrive.com/kai-offer` and `gdrive.com/kai-tax-note`. No gross-up requested initially; manager asked for one-off gross-up review if dual-withholding becomes an issue.

sarah-legal: Flag: splitting payments across jurisdictions can create dual-withholding exposures. We'll need local tax counsel sign-off and language for indemnity if we gross-up. Please include proposed payment schedule in the request.

marc-finance: Finance needs first-year cash schedule and GL code. Alex, confirm payroll currency for the partial first month and whether sign-on will be processed onshore.

alex-recruiter: First-year cash estimate: pro-rated base (~$97k for May-Dec) + sign-on tranche $30k now + $30k at 6mo. Payroll in USD from first US payroll cycle; sign-on to candidate US bank. GL: ENG-PLAT-09.

comp-bot: Approval request generated: https://rbwd/approvals/REQ-2026-0510-44. Approvers: nina-peopleops, comp-committee (chair: joel-comp), marc-finance, sarah-legal. Status: Pending.

nina-peopleops: Routing to comp committee now. I'll tag as "Time-sensitive 10% executive-level" and request expedited review. @joel-comp please triage.

joel-comp (joins thread): I'll review today. If committee approves band uplift, we'll add conditional language for sign-on schedule and tax escalation path.

nina-peopleops: Candidate asks for confirmation within 48 hours. Team, can we commit to committee plus legal review within that window?

sarah-legal: We'll prioritize review but need local counsel input. If comp committee approves, legal will require the tax counsel memo and indemnity language before finalizing.

marc-finance: Finance can provisionally reserve budget but needs final number by EOD tomorrow to include in payroll forecast.

alex-recruiter: Thanks all. I'll update Kai to request 48-hr hold and will add any missing docs to the approval packet. :pray:
